messages.content: You are one member of a parallel architecture inquiry. Return only the contracted JSON. Produce executable mechanisms, APIs, state transitions, and verification rules; do not propose organizational process or prose-only governance.

Evidence: 84 Claude sessions in five days manually performed environment diagnosis, repository archaeology, architecture reconstruction, research synthesis, Lean proof work, refactors, tests, memory/skill creation, and repeated failure analysis. A transcript audit counted 2,067 direct mutations versus 190 subagent dispatches and about 30% human corrections. Prior harness research specifies carrier adapters with zero substrate intelligence, append-only prompt/tool/result capture, projected memory/context, deterministic tools, governed consolidation only after results, session heartbeats, work claim/settle, and context-compaction continuity. The existing free-compute-dev seed has deterministic resolver -> context -> model edit -> apply -> test -> feedback rounds -> expensive escalation, but only one task and no autonomous intake/decomposition/fanout/tool navigation/isolation/integration/memory. The existing LISS cheapest-sufficient fabric just demonstrated 24/24 schema-verified jobs at 24.45 useful jobs/min across Gemini and GitHub Models, with OpenRouter fallback and Claude available. Future volunteer CPU/GPU endpoints can join over Tailscale. The target is a Union-owned software-production fabric that receives territories/problems and keeps observing, decomposing, executing, verifying, integrating, and learning without a Codex or Claude conversation carrying the work.

Your bounded question: Design trajectory memory and retrieval so later missions reuse verified context, failures, and solutions rather than re-deriving them conversationally.

State what is absent from the current seed, give a concrete design, and name a smallest real vertical slice.

The LISS fabric discards the full tool/result transcript after job settlement, so verified context evaporates rather than compounding.","design":["Trajectory Record schema: append-only JSONL per session — {fingerprint, task_class, substrate_hash, tool_sequence:[{call,result,token_cost}], outcome:pass|fail|partial, verified_at, assertions:[{fact,confidence:0.0-1.0,source:test|model}]}. The assertions array is the retrievable artifact, not the raw transcript.","Fingerprint function: sha256(task_class || normalized_error_signature || repo_topology_sketch). Normalized error signature strips line numbers and paths, keeping only error class and call-site shape, so analogous missions across different repos surface the same prior trajectories.","Trajectory store: SQLite with trajectories(fingerprint PK, record_path, outcome, verified_at, staleness_score) and failure_index(error_signature, trajectory_id, resolution, confidence). Both append-only; soft-delete via staleness_score threshold, never hard delete.","Retrieval at mission start: before resolver runs, query failure_index on error signatures in the task description or initial probe output; query trajectories by fingerprint prefix for top-K by confidence*recency. Inject passing assertions as prior_knowledge blocks and failure resolutions as avoid blocks.","Consolidation gate: after mission reaches terminal state (full test suite green or escalation fires), a consolidation agent reads the captured tool/result bus, scores confidence (test-verified=0.9, model-only=0.4, human-corrected=0.95), and writes the record. Never consolidates mid-mission.","Staleness decay: staleness_score = f(substrate_commit_distance, outcome_age_days, downstream_mission_failure_rate_using_this_trajectory). Stale records demoted in retrieval ranking but never deleted, preserving retrospective audit. Score recalculated on each retrieval hit.","Session heartbeat payload gains trajectory_id so mid-session context-compaction reloads the partial tool sequence from the capture bus rather than losing history — hooks directly into the prior harness spec's compaction-continuity mechanism.","Carrier adapter extension: each carrier emits {tool_call, result, token_cost, timestamp, session_id} to the existing append-only capture bus. Consolidation reads from the bus, not from model memory, so no carrier needs to understand the memory schema."],"firstVerticalSlice":["Write consolidate(session_dir) -> trajectory_id: reads an existing seed session's tool/result JSONL, computes fingerprint from task_class + first error signature, scores assertions from test exit code, writes one record to trajectories.db. No new bus infrastructure required.","Write retrieve(task_class, error_sig) -> list[Assertion]: queries trajectories.db top-1 by fingerprint match and confidence, returns a formatted prior_knowledge string the seed prepends to its initial context.","Wire retrieve() into the seed's context-assembly step: if trajectories.db exists and matches, prepend assertion block before resolver prompt. No match proceeds cold as today.","Run the same bugfix task twice: run 1 cold, run 2 with retrieval. Measure token count from existing LISS cost logging. Success: run 2 tokens <= 80% of run 1, zero re-taught corrections, exactly one new db record.","If a retrieved assertion causes test failure in run 2, confidence -= 0.3 and log to failure_index — closes the feedback loop without a separate validation job."],"failureModes":["Fingerprint collision: different tasks hash identically; wrong assertions poison context. Mitigate: include repo_topology_sketch in fingerprint; require outcome=pass before assertion is injection-eligible.","Stale assertion injection: trajectory verified on old substrate injected into changed substrate. Mitigate: gate injection on staleness_score < 0.6; re-run the probe rather than trusting the stored result.","Consolidation on partial success: tests pass against a flawed fixture; wrong high-confidence assertions written. Mitigate: check full test suite exit code and test count; cap confidence at 0.5 if count is below repo baseline.","Retrieval latency: SQLite query over thousands of records adds startup cost. Mitigate: bloom filter over fingerprints in a memory-mapped file; SQLite only on bloom hit.","Schema drift: assertion format changes between fabric versions; old records inject malformed context. Mitigate: version field in every record; migration on read; migration failures treated as retrieval misses, not crashes."],"successMetric":"Two consecutive runs of the same task_class: run 2 uses <= 80% of run 1 tokens, zero human corrections for previously-corrected failure classes, and trajectories.db gains exactly one record. A known error_signature mid-run triggers failure_index lookup in under 50ms with no subsequent re-derivation probe-retry pattern in the captured tool sequence."}

structured_output.absentMechanism: The current seed holds no cross-session state beyond git history. Every mission begins cold: no record of which environment probes succeeded, which error classes have known resolutions, which model+prompt combinations converged, or which integration sequences were verified. The 30% human correction rate is largely re-teaching already-learned lessons. The LISS fabric discards the full tool/result transcript after job settlement, so verified context evaporates rather than compounding.
design: Trajectory Record schema: append-only JSONL per session — {fingerprint, task_class, substrate_hash, tool_sequence:[{call,result,token_cost}], outcome:pass|fail|partial, verified_at, assertions:[{fact,confidence:0.0-1.0,source:test|model}]}. The assertions array is the retrievable artifact, not the raw transcript.

Fingerprint function: sha256(task_class || normalized_error_signature || repo_topology_sketch). Normalized error signature strips line numbers and paths, keeping only error class and call-site shape, so analogous missions across different repos surface the same prior trajectories.

Trajectory store: SQLite with trajectories(fingerprint PK, record_path, outcome, verified_at, staleness_score) and failure_index(error_signature, trajectory_id, resolution, confidence). Both append-only; soft-delete via staleness_score threshold, never hard delete.

Retrieval at mission start: before resolver runs, query failure_index on error signatures in the task description or initial probe output; query trajectories by fingerprint prefix for top-K by confidence*recency. Inject passing assertions as prior_knowledge blocks and failure resolutions as avoid blocks.

Consolidation gate: after mission reaches terminal state (full test suite green or escalation fires), a consolidation agent reads the captured tool/result bus, scores confidence (test-verified=0.9, model-only=0.4, human-corrected=0.95), and writes the record. Never consolidates mid-mission.

Staleness decay: staleness_score = f(substrate_commit_distance, outcome_age_days, downstream_mission_failure_rate_using_this_trajectory). Stale records demoted in retrieval ranking but never deleted, preserving retrospective audit. Score recalculated on each retrieval hit.

Session heartbeat payload gains trajectory_id so mid-session context-compaction reloads the partial tool sequence from the capture bus rather than losing history — hooks directly into the prior harness spec's compaction-continuity mechanism.

Carrier adapter extension: each carrier emits {tool_call, result, token_cost, timestamp, session_id} to the existing append-only capture bus. Consolidation reads from the bus, not from model memory, so no carrier needs to understand the memory schema.
firstVerticalSlice: Write consolidate(session_dir) -> trajectory_id: reads an existing seed session's tool/result JSONL, computes fingerprint from task_class + first error signature, scores assertions from test exit code, writes one record to trajectories.db. No new bus infrastructure required.

Write retrieve(task_class, error_sig) -> list[Assertion]: queries trajectories.db top-1 by fingerprint match and confidence, returns a formatted prior_knowledge string the seed prepends to its initial context.
Wire retrieve() into the seed's context-assembly step: if trajectories.db exists and matches, prepend assertion block before resolver prompt. No match proceeds cold as today.

Run the same bugfix task twice: run 1 cold, run 2 with retrieval. Measure token count from existing LISS cost logging. Success: run 2 tokens <= 80% of run 1, zero re-taught corrections, exactly one new db record.
If a retrieved assertion causes test failure in run 2, confidence -= 0.3 and log to failure_index — closes the feedback loop without a separate validation job.
failureModes: Fingerprint collision: different tasks hash identically; wrong assertions poison context. Mitigate: include repo_topology_sketch in fingerprint; require outcome=pass before assertion is injection-eligible.

Stale assertion injection: trajectory verified on old substrate injected into changed substrate. Mitigate: gate injection on staleness_score < 0.6; re-run the probe rather than trusting the stored result.

Consolidation on partial success: tests pass against a flawed fixture; wrong high-confidence assertions written. Mitigate: check full test suite exit code and test count; cap confidence at 0.5 if count is below repo baseline.
Retrieval latency: SQLite query over thousands of records adds startup cost. Mitigate: bloom filter over fingerprints in a memory-mapped file; SQLite only on bloom hit.

Schema drift: assertion format changes between fabric versions; old records inject malformed context. Mitigate: version field in every record; migration on read; migration failures treated as retrieval misses, not crashes.
structured_output.successMetric: Two consecutive runs of the same task_class: run 2 uses <= 80% of run 1 tokens, zero human corrections for previously-corrected failure classes, and trajectories.db gains exactly one record. A known error_signature mid-run triggers failure_index lookup in under 50ms with no subsequent re-derivation probe-retry pattern in the captured tool sequence.
